description: This file contains a shell script that automates testing of git cherry-pick behavior, including preparation of repositories, commits, and verification of cherry-pick outputs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the provided command sequence.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified changes.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal timestamp for reproducible commits.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
